items.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
items.summary: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.

items.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
items.summary: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

items.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
items.summary: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

items.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

items.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
items.summary: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.

items.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
items.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

items.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
items.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

items.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
items.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.
